methodology: Official public DLD latest-vintage snapshots. Projects require registered number + unique unchanged English name + stable developer identity + compatible official geography, independently reviewed. Community links are administrative area context only. No fuzzy joins, interpolation, future prices, event uplift, or historical point-in-time availability claimed. Raw rows stay private. Usage/type/registration and native subtypes remain explicitly separate; Ejari business property types (including Virtual Unit) are separate; sparse medians retained with n20 display gate. Entire duplicated single-property rental contracts are quarantined; invalid/future start or extreme end dates independently quarantined. Aggregate series overlap and are not additive. New specific first-party project proofs supplement unchanged exact native names/IDs; both raw-source and later identity-review availability are retained. Registered Land/Building asset histories remain published_reference and cannot anchor marketed Unit/Villa prices. Earlier packets are unchanged. All 1523 aggregates retained unchanged, including 1507 subject and 16 separate Land/Building references. Avanti contract starts begin March 2019, after filed December 2018 completion; two future-start contracts are excluded. Signed contracts are not proof of occupancy or cash income. No rent contracts found for Harbour Lights or Coral Reef in this snapshot. Sparse and incomplete-period observations stay labelled and are not promoted to robust medians.
